mapper.select: SELECT TS.SERVICE_ID, TS.WORK_CD, TS.COMPANY_ID, TS.ASSOCIATION_ID, TS.GOVT_ID, TS.BRANCH_ID, TS.SANGSA_ID, TS.MEMBER_ID, (SELECT MAX(TMD.MEMBER_NM) FROM TM_MEMBER_DT TMD WHERE TMD.MEMBER_ID = TS.MEMBER_ID) MEMBER_NM, TS.CAR_NO, TO_CHAR(TS.REQUEST_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') REQUEST_DT, TO_CHAR(TS.PROC_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') PROC_DT, TO_CHAR(TS.JUDGE_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') JUDGE_DT, TS.PROC_ST, TS.JUDGE_ST, TS.RETURN_TX, TS.LINK_ID, TS.IMPO_YN, TS.READ_YN, TS.AUTO_YN FROM TR_SERVICE TS WHERE TS.SERVICE_ID = #{serviceId}

SELECT SERVICE_ID, WORK_CD, CAR_NO, WONBU_ST, COMPANY_ID, MORT_NM, REG_GB, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(REG_NO) REG_NO, BIZ_NO, BOND_AMT, PAY_NM, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(PAY_HP_NO) PAY_HP_NO, PAY_GB, PAY_ME, PAY_ST, TO_CHAR(PAY_DT, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') PAY_DT, VBANK_CD, VBANK_NO, T_VBANK_GB, T_VBANK_ID, TOTAL_AMT, PAY_TP FROM TR_MORTGAGE WHERE SERVICE_ID = #{serviceId}

SELECT SERVICE_ID, WORK_CD, EULBU_NO, CARID_NO, CAR_NM, CAR_KD, CAR_US, CAR_YY, CARREG_DT, MORT_CT, DIST_CT, MORT_NM, TO_CHAR(MORTREG_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') MORTREG_DT FROM TR_CARINFO WHERE SERVICE_ID = #{serviceId} AND ROWNUM = 1

SELECT SERVICE_ID, PAY_KD, PAY_AMT, PAY_OP, PAY_ST, VBANK_CD, VBANK_NO, TO_CHAR(PAY_DT, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') PAY_DT, T_VBANK_GB, T_VBANK_ID FROM TR_PAYMENT WHERE SERVICE_ID = #{serviceId} ORDER BY DECODE(PAY_KD, 'FEE', 1, 'REGIS', 2, 'STAMP', 3, 9)
SELECT ASSOCIATION_ID, COMPANY_ID, BIZ_NO, COMPANY_NO, COMPANY_NM, CEO_NM, POST_NO, ADDRESS, ADDRESS_DT, TEL_NO, MPHONE_NO, USE_YN FROM TM_COMPANY WHERE COMPANY_ID = #{companyId} AND USE_YN = 'Y'

SELECT WORK_CD, COMPANY_ID, GOVT_ID, PERM_GB, PAYMENT_GB, PAYMENT_OP, PAYMENT_TP, PAYMENT_ME, FEE, USE_YN FROM TM_WORK_CP WHERE COMPANY_ID = #{companyId} AND WORK_CD = '001' AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND ROWNUM = 1
SELECT WORK_CD, STAMP_PER, STAMP_AMT, REGIST_PER, REGIST_AMT, STAMP_BASE, REGIST_BASE FROM TM_TAX WHERE WORK_CD = '001' AND SYSDATE BETWEEN START_DT AND END_DT AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND ROWNUM = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TR_SERVICE ( SERVICE_ID, WORK_CD, COMPANY_ID, ASSOCIATION_ID, GOVT_ID, MEMBER_ID, CAR_NO, REQUEST_DT, PROC_ST, BRANCH_ID, SANGSA_ID, JUDGE_ST, RETURN_TX, INS_USER, AUTO_YN, LINK_ID) VALUES ( #{SERVICE_ID}, '001', #{COMPANY_ID}, #{ASSOCIATION_ID}, #{GOVT_ID}, #{MEMBER_ID}, #{CAR_NO}, SYSDATE, #{PROC_ST}, #{BRANCH_ID}, #{SANGSA_ID}, #{JUDGE_ST}, #{RETURN_TX}, #{MEMBER_ID}, #{AUTO_YN}, #{LINK_ID})

INSERT INTO TR_MORTGAGE ( SERVICE_ID, WORK_CD, CAR_NO, WONBU_ST, COMPANY_ID, MORT_NM, REG_GB, REG_NO, BIZ_NO, BOND_AMT, PAY_NM, PAY_HP_NO, PAY_ME, PAY_ST, PAY_DT, PAY_GB, VBANK_CD, VBANK_NO, T_VBANK_GB, T_VBANK_ID, TOTAL_AMT, INS_USER, PAY_TP) VALUES ( #{SERVICE_ID}, '001', #{CAR_NO}, #{WONBU_ST}, #{COMPANY_ID}, #{MORT_NM}, #{REG_GB}, PKG_COMMON.FN_ENCRYPT(#{REG_NO}), #{BIZ_NO}, NVL(#{BOND_AMT}, 0), #{PAY_NM}, PKG_COMMON.FN_ENCRYPT(#{PAY_HP_NO}), #{PAY_ME}, #{PAY_ST}, TO_DATE(#{PAY_DT}, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS'), #{PAY_GB}, #{VBANK_CD}, #{VBANK_NO}, #{T_VBANK_GB}, #{T_VBANK_ID}, NVL(#{TOTAL_AMT}, 0), #{MEMBER_ID}, #{PAY_TP})

INSERT INTO TR_CARINFO ( SERVICE_ID, WORK_CD, EULBU_NO, CARID_NO, CAR_NM, CAR_KD, CAR_US, CAR_YY, CARREG_DT, MORT_CT, DIST_CT, MORT_NM, MORTREG_DT, PRE_CAR_NO, INS_USER) VALUES ( #{SERVICE_ID}, '001', #{EULBU_NO}, #{CARID_NO}, #{CAR_NM}, #{CAR_KD}, #{CAR_US}, #{CAR_YY}, #{CARREG_DT}, #{MORT_CT}, #{DIST_CT}, #{MORT_NM}, TO_DATE(REPLACE(REPLACE(#{MORTREG_DT}, '-', ''), '/', ''), 'YYYYMMDD'), DECODE(LENGTH(#{CAR_NO}), 17, #{CAR_NO}, NULL), #{MEMBER_ID})

INSERT INTO TR_PAYMENT ( SERVICE_ID, PAY_KD, PAY_AMT, PAY_OP, PAY_ST, VBANK_CD, VBANK_NO, PAY_DT, T_VBANK_GB, T_VBANK_ID, INS_USER, PRE_PAY_AMT) VALUES ( #{SERVICE_ID}, #{PAY_KD}, NVL(#{PAY_AMT}, 0), #{PAY_OP}, #{PAY_ST}, #{VBANK_CD}, #{VBANK_NO}, TO_DATE(#{PAY_DT}, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS'), #{T_VBANK_GB}, #{T_VBANK_ID}, #{MEMBER_ID}, NVL(#{PAY_AMT}, 0))
mapper.update: UPDATE TR_MORTGAGE SET CAR_NO = #{CAR_NO}, WONBU_ST = #{WONBU_ST}, MORT_NM = #{MORT_NM}, REG_GB = #{REG_GB}, REG_NO = PKG_COMMON.FN_ENCRYPT(#{REG_NO}), BIZ_NO = #{BIZ_NO}, BOND_AMT = NVL(#{BOND_AMT}, 0), PAY_NM = #{PAY_NM}, PAY_HP_NO = PKG_COMMON.FN_ENCRYPT(#{PAY_HP_NO}), PAY_GB = #{PAY_GB}, PAY_ME = #{PAY_ME}, PAY_ST = #{PAY_ST}, VBANK_CD = #{VBANK_CD}, VBANK_NO = #{VBANK_NO}, TOTAL_AMT = NVL(#{TOTAL_AMT}, 0), PAY_TP = #{PAY_TP}, UPD_USER = #{MEMBER_ID}, UPD_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE SERVICE_ID = #{SERVICE_ID}
UPDATE TR_MORTGAGE SET PAY_NM = #{PAY_NM}, PAY_HP_NO = PKG_COMMON.FN_ENCRYPT(#{PAY_HP_NO}), UPD_USER = #{MEMBER_ID}, UPD_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE SERVICE_ID = #{SERVICE_ID}

UPDATE TR_CARINFO SET EULBU_NO = #{EULBU_NO}, CARID_NO = #{CARID_NO}, CAR_NM = #{CAR_NM}, CAR_KD = #{CAR_KD}, CAR_US = #{CAR_US}, CAR_YY = #{CAR_YY}, CARREG_DT = #{CARREG_DT}, MORT_CT = #{MORT_CT}, DIST_CT = #{DIST_CT}, MORT_NM = #{MORT_NM}, MORTREG_DT = TO_DATE(REPLACE(REPLACE(#{MORTREG_DT}, '-', ''), '/', ''), 'YYYYMMDD'), UPD_USER = #{MEMBER_ID}, UPD_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE SERVICE_ID = #{SERVICE_ID}
mapper.select:
SELECT TS.SERVICE_ID, TS.CAR_NO, TC.CODE_NM PROC_ST, TCM.CODE_NM PAY_ME, TCG.CODE_NM GOVT_NM, TCB.CODE_NM BANK_NM, TM.VBANK_NO, TM.TOTAL_AMT, TO_CHAR(TS.REQUEST_DT, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') REQUEST_DT, TO_CHAR(TS.PROC_DT, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') PROC_DT, TO_CHAR(TM.PAY_DT, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') PAY_DT, TP_REGIS.PAY_AMT REGIS_AMT, TP_REGIS.VBANK_NO REGIS_NO, TP_FEE.PAY_AMT FEE_AMT, TP_STAMP.PAY_AMT STAMP_AMT FROM TR_SERVICE TS JOIN TR_MORTGAGE TM ON TS.SERVICE_ID = TM.SERVICE_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CODE_ID, CODE_NM FROM TM_CODE WHERE GROUP_ID = 'PR_ST') TC ON TS.PROC_ST = TC.CODE_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CODE_ID, CODE_NM FROM TM_CODE WHERE GROUP_ID = 'PAYME') TCM ON TM.PAY_ME = TCM.CODE_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CODE_ID, CODE_NM FROM TM_CODE WHERE GROUP_ID = 'GOVT') TCG ON TS.GOVT_ID = TCG.CODE_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CODE_ID, CODE_NM FROM TM_CODE WHERE GROUP_ID = 'BANK') TCB ON TM.VBANK_CD = TCB.CODE_ID LEFT JOIN TR_PAYMENT TP_FEE ON TS.SERVICE_ID = TP_FEE.SERVICE_ID AND TP_FEE.PAY_KD = 'FEE' LEFT JOIN TR_PAYMENT TP_REGIS ON TS.SERVICE_ID = TP_REGIS.SERVICE_ID AND TP_REGIS.PAY_KD = 'REGIS' LEFT JOIN TR_PAYMENT TP_STAMP ON TS.SERVICE_ID = TP_STAMP.SERVICE_ID AND TP_STAMP.PAY_KD = 'STAMP' WHERE TS.WORK_CD = '001' AND TS.CAR_NO IN
#{carNo}
AND
TS.PROC_DT TM.PAY_DT TS.REQUEST_DT
BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{START_DT} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND TO_DATE(#{END_DT} || '235959', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND TS.PROC_ST NOT IN ('DEL', 'RET') AND TM.PAY_ST = 'Y' ORDER BY TS.REQUEST_DT DESC

SELECT TS.SERVICE_ID, TS.WORK_CD, TS.CAR_NO, TS.COMPANY_ID, TC.COMPANY_NM, TO_CHAR(TS.REQUEST_DT, 'MM.DD HH24:MI') AS REQUEST_DT, TS.PROC_ST FROM TR_SERVICE TS, TM_COMPANY TC WHERE TS.COMPANY_ID = TC.COMPANY_ID AND TS.WORK_CD = 'ERSGRP' AND TS.REQUEST_DT BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{START_DT} || '00:00:00', 'YYYYMMDDHH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(#{END_DT} || '23:59:59', 'YYYYMMDDHH24:MI:SS') ORDER BY TS.REQUEST_DT DESC

SELECT SERVICE_ID, WORK_CD, COMPANY_ID, ASSOCIATION_ID, GOVT_ID, BRANCH_ID, SANGSA_ID, MEMBER_ID, CAR_NO, TO_CHAR(REQUEST_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS REQUEST_DT, PROC_DT, TO_CHAR(JUDGE_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS JUDGE_DT, PROC_ST, JUDGE_ST, RETURN_TX, INS_USER, INS_DATE, UPD_USER, UPD_DATE, LINK_ID, IMPO_YN, READ_YN, AUTO_YN FROM TR_SERVICE WHERE SERVICE_ID = #{SERVICE_ID}
mapper.update: UPDATE TR_SERVICE SET AUTO_YN = 'N', ERROR_MSG = '관청 강제수동처리', UPD_DATE = SYSDATE, UPD_USER = #{UPD_USER} WHERE SERVICE_ID = #{SERVICE_ID} AND GOVT_ID = 'HAMYA'
